summary: Short frontend test of the Cotizador VPOS scope grid (StoresBoxesGrid) brand ordering + brand headers. Flow: /quotes -> create-quote-button -> Clientes Pymes (new-impl-pyme) -> VPOS (Cajas) -> scope-level-GRUPO -> existing group 'Farmacias San Ignacio Grupo J&A' (grp_c0079160704b, 2 brands: FARMACIA SAN IGNACIO [3 RIF], FARMACIAS SAN IGNACIO GRUPO J&A [6 RIF]) -> scope-brands-select-all -> RIFs picked in REVERSE order (J&A: FSI BISCUCUY, FARMACIA PTO CABELLO; then A: FARMACIA SAN IGNACIO LA 20, FARMA MERCADO). The legal names sort INTERLEAVED across brands alphabetically (FARMA MERCADO, FARMACIA PTO CABELLO(J&A), FARMACIA SAN IGNACIO LA 20, FSI...), so this was a real test of the ordering. Result: grid shows header 'MARCA: FARMACIA SAN IGNACIO' (2 RIF · 2 tienda(s) · 0 cajas) with FARMA MERCADO, FARMACIA SAN IGNACIO LA 20 under it, then header 'MARCA: FARMACIAS SAN IGNACIO GRUPO J&A' with FARMACIA PTO CABELLO CENTRO, FSI BISCUCUY. No interleaving, brands A-Z, RIFs A-Z inside each brand. With only J&A RIFs selected, a single header was shown. Boxes: entering 3,2,5,1 updated headers to 5 and 6 cajas, total 11; un-checking FARMA MERCADO's store -> header 1 tienda(s) · 2 cajas, total 8. Global mode hides the cajas part of the header and the total bar. Tipología shows 'Multi Marca'. No quote saved. No TEST_SG data created (used an existing group, read-only), so nothing to clean up.

issues: Low: brand headers are not sticky inside the max-h-72 scroll area, so when one brand has many stores its header scrolls out of view. Could use sticky top-0.

critical_code_review_comments: The scope-brand-header-{brand} testid uses the raw brand name (spaces, '&', accents). It works, but it is fragile for selectors. Consider using the marca_id or a slug.

The brand header is rendered inside the first RIF's scope-rif-block div. That is fine visually, but the brand is not its own container. Wrapping each brand in a group element would be cleaner and would make sticky headers easy.
brandRifs/brandBoxes are recomputed with rifs.filter for every row (O(n^2)). This is negligible at current sizes.
seed_data_creation: None. Used existing group grp_c0079160704b, read-only. No quotes saved.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login: POST /api/auth/login returns session_token; set localStorage 'session_token' and then reach /quotes via history.pushState + popstate, because direct goto redirects to /dashboard. Poll until create-quote-button exists, because it can load slowly. Open the Radix dropdown with a pointerdown dispatch, then click new-impl-pyme. Checklist testids: scope-groups-search, scope-groups-check-{group_id}, scope-brands-select-all, scope-rifs-check-{client_id}. Box inputs: [data-testid=scope-rif-block-{cid}] input[data-testid^=scope-store-boxes-].
